title: Do You See Ten Vans?
lines: Gus and Mom sit in a bus.
The bus hums. "A jet!" said Gus.
Gus sits up. "A hat! A bin!" he said.
Mom nods. "We see six vans," she said.
"I do not see ten," said Gus. His lip dips.
A lot of red vans are in the hot fog!
"Ten! We have ten!" said Gus, and he hops up.
Mom hugs Gus and pats him.
scoring_note: This passage says "do not". Decodability forbids apostrophes. A child who reads "don't" is reading for meaning — do not score it an error.
